state.review:
Great experience everytime I come to Serenity Dental!
Very quick, painless and pleasant time here. Thank you [name] and staff :)

Serenity Dental is truly the best! The entire team is incredibly kind and genuinely cares about your comfort and well-being. They always take the time to make sure you feel at ease and never rushed. I can’t recommend them highly enough!

I have visited this place for my dental care and for my kids dental care. Doctors are so helpful and very much caring on our issues.. they are keep following up after the procedure to make sure we are comfortable. I highly recommend Serenity dental.
Great experience! Staff was friendly and professional.  A+ from start to finish.

[name], the dentist who previously owned this facility, was a good dentist. [name] was not. I generally don't leave 1 star reviews, but she is below average in my opinion. I struggled to communicate even basic things with her, and ultimately it led to a lot of pain and inconvenience that didn't need to happen. I'd recommend finding another dentist.

[name] was great and very efficient. I had to have a tooth pulled and a root canal in another tooth the same day. Her assistants, Robin and [name] were great about keeping things light and calm. I live in the Amli Covered Bridge apartments so I feel fortunate to have a great dentist so close. Since this was an emergency appointment I look forward to our planned visits from now on.

My crown broke and within days they were able to fit me in and have a temporary crown made and a new crown ordered. [name] and her staff are very friendly and helpful and made me feel comfortable. I’m so glad I found them and their location is very convenient and office is clean and relaxing too! I highly recommend!

Fantastic experience with this staff. They got me in quickly on short notice and were incredible professional and kind.  Actually had fun going to the dentist for once!  Glad I finally found a good practice here in Austin to routinely go to.
Great dentist. Nice office. Great staff. Professional and helpful. Cant say enough.
Super cool staff really focused on the patient experience recommend if you're afraid of the dentist

[name] and her staff are fantastic! [name] does your teeth cleaning for you which I’ve never experienced. Most offices have an assistant do it and then the [name] in, poke at your teeth and say see ya in 6 months. I so appreciate that the [name] the cleaning, to me it demonstrates how much she cares about her patients and quality of work! She’s helpful in answering any questions and really leans into PREVENTATIVE maintenance which I feel is often overlooked. Staff has always been really kind and fun to chat with. Would highly recommend making this your office of choice !! I’m moving but planning on coming back to have my future cleanings here :)
Doctor is great as well as staff! I laughed from time in until time out. Way to create a great environment while providing service!
Receptionist is a tad sassy but great service overall!

It is always a great experience at Serenity Dental. My family has been coming here for years and their quality of service is truly unmatched. If you struggle with dental anxiety, I cannot recommend Serenity Dental enough. They value patient comfort and I actually look forward to my appointments now!
Been going here for years. Love the staff! My daughter does too.

I had such a great experience at this office! Esme and [name] were both incredibly sweet and so fun to be around—professional, but with a really welcoming energy that made the whole visit feel comfortable. [name] was amazing—super informative and took the time to explain everything clearly without rushing through. The fact that the entire practice is women-led honestly makes me even more excited to come back. Love supporting a space that’s not only efficient and knowledgeable, but empowering too!

[name] operates a truly first-class dental office. (My teeth/smile) and I have benefited from her extraordinary talents, professionalism and humanity. Her staff is outstanding. I could not recommend her more highly.
Our favorite dentist! Feels like home. Gentle and effective cleanings
Wonderful staff. Friendly, explained everything to me. Have already recommended them to my friends. Great experience👍
Great staff and dentist. They make you feel very comfortable and are very detailed in explaining anything that needs to be done. I would recommend to everyone!

Loved this place! Everyone was so sweet and personable. They were super efficient and I was in and out quickly. Making my boyfriend go see her soon! (Also non-judgemental. hadn’t been to the dentist in like 3 years)
I’m convinced that [name] and her entire staff are angels sent from heaven. I can’t even express how grateful I am for everything they’ve done for my oral health. Thank you!!!
[name] and the staff at Serenity are wonderful. She is very thorough and really takes time to discuss treatment options. The cleanings are quick - in and out under an hour!

My favorite dentist by far! She's so personable and makes cleanings quick, read, and painless. Her staff is always friendly and do a really great job. I could go on and on about how great this place is!
Easy and relaxing visit. Dentist and assistant explained everything. 👍 Manager took care of check in and payment. Pretty office 🤞🏼
Always a great experience. [name] and her staff are wonderful. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great dentist.
My whole family gets great care here. We’re so grateful for the authentic service

I love SW Austin dental ! The ladies who work in the front office are pleasant, professional and helpful answering my questions.
[name] is so thorough and obviously a perfectionist! She explains her reasoning behind her recommendations and she explains what she is doing while she works.
She is very knowledgeable and seems to attend courses all the time keeping informed on the best treatment for her patients.
You can't go wrong with her as your dentist!
Really nice service.
Always a very pleasant and comfortable experience especially for a dentist!!! :)

I’ve just moved to Texas and needed a dentist immediately. I found this place on Zocdoc and booked an appointment, giving them a call and speaking with [name] about my insurance (I was unsure if they took it or not). Then I was sent all my check in sheets ahead of time, giving me the ability to come in and simply hand them over. I was able to meet with [name] with 10 minutes of arrival. I was there for about 1.5 hours, but there was no ideal time, as I got my x-rays done by Robin,  my teeth cleaned and inspected, an explanations of what the doctor was looking at and identifying, as well as a thorough breakdown of my treatment plan. I’d highly recommend this practice if you are someone who wants a doctor and staff that are knowledgeable, friendly, straightforward and helpful. Looking forward to this new relationship!
Amazing team and they took great care of me!

I had a very disappointing experience at this dental office. I felt pressured into getting a deep cleaning (scaling and root planing) and paying out of pocket for it, when in reality, my insurance would have covered it if I had just waited for the waiting period to end. The dentist made it seem like insurance wouldn’t cover the treatment at all, which wasn’t true. I ended up spending nearly $1,000 for a procedure that took less than 10 minutes.

Regular cleanings weren’t even offered, only the more expensive deep cleaning. I was also told I needed multiple fillings, but after getting a second opinion, I found out that four of the suggested fillings were completely unnecessary.

The whole experience felt more focused on profit than on patient care. I’d strongly recommend getting a second opinion before agreeing to any treatment here.
Super friendly and helpful staff. Got my Invisalign done here and they were great throughout the entire process.

I was wonderfully pleased with my experience at SW Austin Dental. I’ve always had a fear of the dentist and my mind was put at ease thanks to my hygienist (whose name I can’t remember unfortunately) and [name]. They were able to very clearly explain what’s going on in my mouth and recommend ways to move forward. I left with important knowledge on how to better care for my teeth and gums and a wonderfully clean mouth with virtually no pain (which is a rarity in my dental experiences). I very much look forward to returning to SW Austin Dental. My issue is already noticeably healing and feeling better only a few hours after my appointment. Thanks [name] and my hygienist from AL! (Sorry I can’t remember your name!)
I highly recommend. Best dentist experience I have ever had. They really care and do a great job!
Excellent service, [name] is great and all other employees. I love her services and the staff

I always love coming in for my check ups or whatever I need done. [name] is such a sweet and compassionate person, and you can feel how much she cares about you and your treatment. Also, all of the hygienists and front desk workers always are kind and friendly, and they all work together to always deliver a wonderful experience!

I have never enjoyed going to dentist until I found [name]. Now I eagerly await each cleaning. She and [name] are PROS. Both incredibly knowledgeable, thorough, and kind. Bottom of my heart cannot recommend this practice enough.

Absolute best dentist!  Been coming here for 8 years now.  Previously saw [name], who retired and chose [name] as his successor.    She is just as talented and friendly.  All of the hygienists are wonderful, but [name] is my favorite.  Relaxing treatment and conservative with recommending additional work-up.  Feels like family!
Great service! And [name] is amazing!

I came here for the first time around 5 months ago after years of putting off going to the dentist. [name] immediately identified the issues I was having and explained in detail what the next steps involved, being fully transparent about the process and prices throughout. Not to mention the repair and maintenance of my dental health was/is nearly painless!

Everyone I’ve encountered here is exceptional and kind hearted, taking great care of you. 10/10 recommend.
I am a bit biased as I knew [name] at NYU.  She was bright, sunny, driven, and comptent then, and now I see an outstanding clinician who is kind and caring. You will enjoy your time in her chair.

I had [name] do my dental examination, she was very patient, thorough, and walked me through every step of the process. She is not only highly knowledgeable, but is also able to explain complex dental issues in a simple manner so I can understand it.
Wonderful, wonderful and wonderful from start to finish.  The staff and the dentist was awesome 👏.  Would definitely go back and also refer others.  Totally satisfied.
The staff is always so welcoming and friendly. The office is conveniently located and very clean. [name] is so knowledgeable and has a great bedside manner. Happy to have found this office!

Serenity Dental provides an exceptional dental experience. [name] and her team are knowledgeable, attentive, and truly make patient care their top priority. Whenever I call, they pick up right away, making scheduling and questions easy. Every visit feels professional yet welcoming, and their expertise ensures you leave with confidence in your dental health. Highly recommend!
Great customer service, the dentist explained everything to me and Consistently  reassured my nerves and did everything to make me comfortable. Very good expirence

[name] always greets with a friendly smile and takes an interest in your life outside of the office. My experience was truly second to none, with any procedure you get done; her goal is to make it as comfortable and painless as possible.  I highly recommend Serenity Dental to anyone looking for an amazing dentist. The staff is very friendly and the office is always clean.

Great Experience! [name] was very professional and answered all of my questions. Her hygienist was very sweet! Definitely recommend! For the first time in my life - I’m looking forward to my next appointment!
Thank you [name] for excellent reception and [name] for thorough service.

If I could give 6 stars I would.. first and foremost I want to say thank you to [name], [name], and [name] for letting someone that hasn’t been to the dentist in 10 yrs that everything was going to be okay.. I was scared but put my scared level at 4/5 to look cool.. just a weird feeling going back to the dentist knowing you need work done..

[name] was great. There was no wait, she explained everything, and even helped understand how things would work in the two most important realms to me: financially and timeline.

Thank you and I’ll be sure to tell anyone that needs dental work to go to Serenity Dental.

I’m so sorry as well because I forgot the names of the two lovely ladies (one from Chicagoland) that did my fillings today. It was early and my mouth was numb so please don’t hold it against me!
Always a great experience, they are very helpful and tell you everything you need to know

The environment was welcoming and I received an excellent customer service from SW Austin dental. It is a Very modern clinic and they explained things very well. I am impresses with exceptional attention they give to every patients. I highly recommend them.
[name] and her staff are wonderful and caring. They make going to the dentist a smooth experience! She is the best!!
Beautiful facility and great doc. Dr.razzaq is the best:)

I don't know what happened with the one star reviewer, but it must not have resembled in any way whatsoever my many visits to [name]. [name] is skilled, strong, and always empathetic. The hygienists, receptionist and billing person are extremely efficient and very pleasant. This practice has a good vibe! Have had several crowns done there, as well as regular cleanings. The previous dentist, [name], was also excellent. But [name] is truly special. (This from someone who hates going to the dentist.)

I am rewriting my review.

Upon the Dr. entering the room, she laughed at me for being cold and using a blanket they provided,  never introduced herself by name or otherwise, and just seemed annoyed she had to do her job. Needs less to say, I felt as if I were a burden and not a valued patient. Then the salesman came in, up selling and up selling, you’ll save money if you buy our special plan. I asked why one tooth was so much more expensive and then the price changed. He said,” ohh, they made a mistake.” Probably not the only one. And to make matters even better, I’ve been receiving emails about appointments I did not schedule. I finally called to figure out what was going on and I am told that I scheduled these on my first visit. I did not and had decided to not return and call it a trial and error waste of money. So why would I schedule appointments? Just be careful.

Ohh, and not to be a total downer. The support staff, ie the nurses, were great! Thank you ladies for all your hard work and level of true caring you put into the job.
everyone was so sweet and my cleaning was great! they also gave a cost rundown prior to even checking in which feels unheard of (in the best way!!)
Super location, very modern office and most of all amazing staff!
They fixed me up fast and the staff is super friendly

The staff is always polite and kind, and the office is always clean — you can feel it as soon as you walk in. I’ve been coming here for years, even since the pandemic, and the doctor is truly caring. They take the time to really get to know you and always make sure you follow up on your dental health.

I’ve been able to keep her as my dentist because I truly trust her. I’ve never felt like they were trying to upsell or overcharge me. My dentist is also very direct — she tells me what I don’t want to hear, but what I need to hear. I know I’ll get “in trouble” if I don’t take care of my teeth — and honestly, I appreciate that accountability!

If y’all want a dentist, this is the one to go for!!

[name] is highly skilled, with great ability to keep me comfortable while completing a complicated crown. She answered all my questions up front. Scheduling was easy and I will be back with the kids for family cleanings.
Everyone here is friendly, amazing and accommodating. The cleaning is smooth and pain free. Hassle free scheduling of appointments.

I found [name] because her practice was in network and close to my work and home. I FOLLOWED [name] across town because she’s the best dentist I’ve ever had. The new office is a delight, easy to get to, and every single person who works there is patient, professional, kind, and thorough. It’s a pleasure going into a practice where everyone clearly takes such pride in their work. [name] was so helpful and welcoming. It’s easy to fall into the habit of avoiding doctors and dentists but Serenity Dental makes me look forward to my appointments. Thank you!

I had been going to the same dental office for 18 years, but my dentist retired, so I was nervous to find a new one. The entire staff is one of the most welcoming and kind staff I’ve ever encountered! [name] was great and she spent time with me and walked me through pictures of my teeth and explained everything so  thorough before my cleaning. Their office is clean and the equipment seems top notch. I highly recommend based on my first appointment and cleaning.

I had a great experience with [name] and [name] at Serenity Dental! They made me feel comfortable, explained everything to me and were extremely nice and helpful. I would recommend this place to everyone!

[name] and her team are excellent! I have very sensitive teeth and they were very accomodating and listened to all my concerns. I highly recommend!

I found my dentist in Austin. Four fillings, pain-free, believe it or not! I was so tired coming in; they even pampered me with a cup of coffee, Netflix, and noise-canceling headphones. All these without sacrificing quality. Thank you, Serenity Dental.

ATTN Austinites with teeth! Let's talk. I've lived here since '98, and over the years, I've had five dentists. None compares to the quality, care, and attentiveness of [name] and her staff. They're friendly, upbeat, informative, candid, and transparent about treatment options and costs. The office has high ceilings, state-of-the-art equipment, and relaxing natural views. If I ever have to move, I'm flying back to them for my dental needs.
Super great and patient through my Invisalign process
The most amazing staff and customer service. [name] is the best Dentist I have ever seen. She and her staff do incredible work and I am so happy I found Serenity Dental.
Great patient experience!  Friendly staff.  Informative and thorough about treatment options.
Love this place! Such a safe and welcoming environment. everyone here goes above and beyond! I will be back!

By far one of my favorite places now. I was always so scared of the dentist but everyone here is so welcoming and comforting. From the receptionist, to Esme the hygienist, to [name]. Couldn’t recommend this place more.

From start to finish the service was great. This was my first ever time seeing a dentist and getting dental work in all of my 33 years of life and I could do it again. My son also had an appointment. He had been traumatized by a recent, unrelated, hospital visit, and was unsure about seeing the dentist.  He was hesitant at first, but [name] walked him through his dental appointment. He started off turning his body sideways to avoid making eye contact, but in the end he ended up laying back and listening, even responding to her questions at times.

When it was my turn, I had [name] as a hygienist. She walked me through the cleaning and was so reassuring and patient with me. With this being my first time ever seeing a dentist or getting dental work, I had no idea what to expect. There was a minimal amount of times I expressed discomfort and as soon as I did, she stopped immediately, applied more gel, then worked on another area until she discomforted area was for sure numb.

[name] literally walked me through it. As soon as I heard the drill come on, I felt a little anxiety. As soon as the filling started, I hear her not only comforting me through it but also coaching and explaining things to the assistant who was helping her at the time. As soon as a major part was done, she offered to take a break so that I can gather myself. I told her that it was not what I expected and went so smoothly that I was ready to start the next part right away. It was over before I knew it.

For my first dental appointment, this was not only thorough, but very comforting through the entire process. I don’t want to find a professional to help back home in the DFW, I am perfectly fine coming back to [name]’s office in the future.
Great experience! [name] was very nice and down to earth. I hadn’t been to the dentist in awhile but everyone there was very nice!
Very professional staff (shout-out to Holly!). [name] is informative and has a great bedside manner. The office is clean and modern. A great dentist's office!
I highly recommend Serenity Dental. The staff is wonderful and made me feel very comfortable. They’re knowledgeable, personable and kind!
Great first visit. Friendly staff. Nice new office. No wait. Will be back!

super nice staff, great customer service, very knowledgeable and quick. great experience

Absolutely the best dental office I have visited in years. [name] is gentle and takes the time to explain everything. Her staff is just as amazing. They squeezed me in for a broken tooth and were so welcoming and friendly. I found my new dentist!

You’ll feel like family here. Out of pocket pricing was very reasonable.

[name] has been incredibly kind and compassionate in helping me keep my periodontitis at bay after moving from Houston. I appreciate her preventative approach to dentistry, I wish she had been my dentist decades ago!

I have never had a dentist spend so much time with me; it made the experience all the more comfortable and top-notch.  I left with my teeth feeling and looking great!
Kind and gentle team led by Dr.Nair!!
